create_pil_to_numpy: convert a PIL image or list of PIL images to a NumPy array
create_numpy_to_pt: convert a NumPy image array to a PyTorch tensor
create_load_image: load an image from a local path or URL and return a PIL Image
create_load_video: load a video from a local path or URL and return a list of PIL Images
create_resize_image: resize a PIL image to specified height and width with lanczos resampling
